main.description: Re-send the signup verification link for a pending signup. Re-mails the same live link (same token, no new invite code) for a signup begun but not yet completed; fails when nothing is in flight for the email or the link has expired.

email.description: Email address used to begin the signup.

errors.name: SignupDisabled
errors.description: Signup is not currently enabled on this service.

errors.name: InvalidEmail
errors.description: The email address is not valid.

errors.name: NoPendingSignup
errors.description: There is no pending (unexpired) signup for this email; start again from the signup page.

errors.name: TooManyRequests
errors.description: A signup email was sent for this address very recently; wait before asking for another.
